summary.zh: 改善 macOS 安装体验，并上线可持续维护的正式更新日志。
summary.en: Improved the macOS installation experience and launched a maintainable public changelog.

added.zh: 官网新增正式更新日志，可按版本查看 Blink 的新增、改进、修复与已知问题。
added.en: Added a public website changelog with versioned features, improvements, fixes, and known issues.

improved.zh: 修正 macOS DMG 的背景与窗口布局，使拖拽安装入口和说明更清晰。
improved.en: Refined the macOS DMG background and window layout for clearer drag-to-install guidance.

improved.zh: 官网现在按明确的安装包命名与架构选择 macOS Apple Silicon 和 Windows x64 下载，避免误选辅助或其他架构文件。
improved.en: The website now selects macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64 installers by explicit naming and architecture, avoiding auxiliary or mismatched assets.

knownIssues.zh: macOS 版本目前仍为 Apple Silicon 测试构建，尚未完成 Developer ID 签名与 Apple 公证。
knownIssues.en: The macOS release remains an Apple Silicon test build without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.

summary.zh: 改进 macOS 安装镜像的生成可靠性，并保持 Windows 安装包同步发布。
summary.en: Improved the reliability of macOS installer image generation while keeping Windows installers available in the same release.

fixed.zh: 修复自定义 macOS DMG 在打包过程中可能因临时文件位置而失败的问题。
fixed.en: Fixed a custom macOS DMG packaging failure caused by where temporary output was created.

knownIssues.zh: macOS 版本目前仅提供 Apple Silicon 测试构建，首次启动可能需要按 DMG 内说明解除 quarantine。
knownIssues.en: The macOS build is currently an Apple Silicon test build and may require the quarantine workaround documented in the DMG.

summary.zh: 修复 macOS 发布流程定位应用包的问题。
summary.en: Fixed app discovery in the macOS release packaging flow.

fixed.zh: 提高从生成的安装镜像中识别 Blink.app 的可靠性。
fixed.en: Made locating Blink.app inside the generated installer image more reliable.

summary.zh: 改善 macOS 下载后的安装体验，并加强正式发布路径。
summary.en: Improved the macOS post-download installation experience and hardened the public release path.

improved.zh: macOS 安装镜像加入更清晰的拖拽安装与首次启动说明。
improved.en: Added clearer drag-to-install and first-launch guidance to the macOS installer image.

improved.zh: 官网可根据公开 Release 提供 macOS Apple Silicon 与 Windows x64 下载。
improved.en: The website can offer macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64 downloads from the public release.

knownIssues.zh: macOS 构建尚未完成 Apple 公证。
knownIssues.en: The macOS build is not yet notarized by Apple.

summary.zh: 发布维护版本，并为官网提供按平台汇总的公开下载统计。
summary.en: Shipped a maintenance release and added platform-level public download totals to the website.

added.zh: 官网可汇总正式版本的 macOS 与 Windows 安装包下载次数。
added.en: The website can aggregate installer download counts across public macOS and Windows releases.

summary.zh: 维护版本；现有记录不足以确认独立的用户可感知变化。
summary.en: Maintenance release; the available records do not establish a distinct user-visible change.

summary.zh: 维护版本；与 v0.1.6 基于同一源码提交，未记录独立的用户可感知变化。
summary.en: Maintenance release from the same source commit as v0.1.6, with no separately recorded user-visible change.

summary.zh: 改进 macOS 应用切换与快捷键执行可靠性，并让安装包版本与发布 tag 保持一致。
summary.en: Improved macOS app switching and shortcut execution reliability, with installer versions derived from the release tag.

improved.zh: 增强 macOS 上呼出后台应用及执行系统快捷键时的可靠性。
improved.en: Improved reliability when bringing background apps forward and running system shortcuts on macOS.

improved.zh: 正式安装包版本现在由发布 tag 驱动，减少版本号不一致。
improved.en: Release tags now drive installer versions, reducing version mismatches.

summary.zh: 提供面向 macOS 与 Windows 的正式安装包，并改善官网的下载体验。
summary.en: Delivered macOS and Windows installers and improved the website download experience.

improved.zh: 官网可按访问平台显示对应下载入口，并支持中英文内容。
improved.en: The website can present the appropriate platform download with Chinese and English copy.

fixed.zh: 修复 Windows 正式版启动时出现额外控制台窗口的问题。
fixed.en: Fixed an extra console window appearing when launching Windows release builds.

fixed.zh: 修复官网首次加载时可能出现的语言闪烁。
fixed.en: Fixed a language flash during the website's first paint.

summary.zh: 与 v0.1.3 基于同一源码提交发布，包含相同的跨平台安装包与体验修复。
summary.en: Released from the same source commit as v0.1.3, with the same cross-platform installers and experience fixes.

improved.zh: 官网增加中英文、按平台识别的下载入口。
improved.en: Added localized, platform-aware downloads to the website.

fixed.zh: Windows 正式版不再显示额外控制台窗口。
fixed.en: Windows release builds no longer show an extra console window.

fixed.zh: 减少官网初次加载时的语言切换闪烁。
fixed.en: Reduced language switching flash during initial website load.

summary.zh: 首个公开维护版本，重点提高 Runtime 与发布构建的可靠性。
summary.en: The first public maintenance release, focused on Runtime and release-build reliability.

improved.zh: 增强本地配置持久化、备份、诊断和脚本进程处理。
improved.en: Improved local configuration persistence, backups, diagnostics, and script process handling.

improved.zh: 增加双平台正式构建验证，降低发布损坏安装包的风险。
improved.en: Added production build verification on both platforms to reduce the risk of broken installers.

summary.zh: Blink 首个正式版本：把应用、网页、脚本和快捷键动作绑定到实体按键。
summary.en: Blink's first formal release: bind apps, URLs, scripts, and keyboard shortcuts to physical keys.

added.zh: 创建、导入和管理本地快捷命令。
added.en: Create, import, and manage local shortcut commands.

added.zh: 将可识别的实体按键绑定到打开 App、URL、脚本或系统快捷键。
added.en: Bind recognizable physical keys to apps, URLs, scripts, or system shortcuts.

added.zh: 提供 macOS Apple Silicon 与 Windows x64 安装包。
added.en: Provided installers for macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
